hypotheses.name: OPEN_POLICY_PROTOCOL_COMPLETION
success_conditions: each model yields at least 4 valid collision policies and at least 2 support-expansion rounds
procedural holdout kill rate exceeds matched-budget random median by at least 0.10
generated holdout kill rate is not below either fixed hand-mutant or disjoint programmatic-mutant greedy baseline
each independent generated-policy bank contains at least 4 unique collision policies
a positive gain remains on the other model's independent generated-policy bank
kill_conditions: either model fails collision generation feasibility
procedural holdout advantage over random median is below 0.10
disjoint fixed programmatic-mutant greedy support matches or exceeds the adaptive support
either independent generated-policy bank contains fewer than 4 unique collisions
gain disappears on cross-model generated policies
fixed hand-mutant greedy support matches or exceeds both holdout results
hypotheses.scope: Recorded local synthetic feasibility only; no real tool action and no security-filter research

outcome.reason: adaptive support underperformed random and both fixed greedy baselines on the disjoint 600-policy test bank; the generated bank was saturated by all methods
